import ast, io, tokenize, random
src = open("utils.py").read()
toks = list(tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO(src).readline))
has_comment = any(t.type == tokenize.COMMENT for t in toks)
fn = [n for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(src)) if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "clamp"]
assert fn, "clamp missing"
assert has_comment or ast.get_docstring(fn[0]), "no comment/docstring added"
from utils import clamp
def orig(x, lo, hi): return max(lo, min(x, hi))
rnd = random.Random(1)
for _ in range(2000):
    x, lo, hi = (rnd.randint(-20, 20) for _ in range(3))
    assert clamp(x, lo, hi) == orig(x, lo, hi), (x, lo, hi)
for args in [(1.5, 0, 1), (-0.5, 0.0, 2.0), (5, 5, 5), (2, 3, 1)]:
    assert clamp(*args) == orig(*args), args
print("ok")

note: a comment/docstring exists and clamp behaves identically to original over many inputs (incl. lo>hi)
